bodies.linkedin:
The LLM node structured 15 of 16 rows correctly in a test, with one error where a salary disbursement was mislabeled as a credit.

Automated document extraction for financial statements should prioritize deterministic arithmetic validation over reliance on vision models to ensure accuracy. The design rule for the workflow is that the model never touches a number it could invent.

In the n8n library, there are 17 paid listings against 177 free ones for document extraction. A review pass identified eight flaws in the system, all of which have been addressed. Even with these fixes, reconciliation against a real statement containing a balance column remains unproven.

When the digital PDF parse reached 16/16 rows, 100% reconciled, it proved the end-to-end path of scan, OCR, parse, and reconcile using a demo image-only PDF. The model slips, but the reconciliation catches it instead of shipping it.

Deterministic validation is the only way to ensure accuracy.
